settings.heading: About Kapaas
settings.paragraph1: At Kapaas, we believe fabric isn’t just material — it’s the beginning of every story you stitch, we curate beautiful, ready-to-use printed and dyed fabrics that are crafted to fuel your creativity, whether you're designing clothing, home decor, or handmade art.
settings.paragraph2: We specialize in Poplin, Rayon, Cambric, and Satin fabrics, offered in pre-measured fixed packs of 3m, 5m, and 10m — no hassle, no cutting queues, just seamless access to quality.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: We process and dispatch all orders within 24 to 48 hours after you place them. Once shipped, delivery usually takes between 3 to 7 business days, depending on your location and the courier service in your area.

settings.question: Do you offer free shipping?
settings.answer: We currently do not offer free shipping. Shipping charges will be calculated at checkout based on your location and the total order weight.

settings.question: Can I buy fabric in custom lengths?
settings.answer: Yes, you can buy fabric in custom lengths. Please select the required length on the product page or contact us if you have specific requirements.

settings.question: What types of fabrics do you offer?
settings.answer: We offer a variety of fabrics including cotton, linen, silk, blends, and more. Please browse our collections to see the full range of fabrics available.

settings.question: Are your fabrics pre-washed or pre-shrunk?
settings.answer: Unless specifically mentioned in the product description, most of our fabrics are not pre-washed or pre-shrunk. We recommend pre-washing your fabric before use to prevent any shrinkage.
